plan.summary: BRO-6767: add the Met premiere run of seven staging-matched current revivals as separate closed past runs, linked from the revival

actions.description: Add the 2017 Met premiere run of Tosca as a closed past run and link it from the current revival

show.title: Tosca
show.synopsis: Puccini's thriller of a singer, a painter and a police chief in Rome, in the Met's staging by David McVicar that opened on New Year's Eve 2017.

actions.description: Add the 2018 Met premiere run of Samson et Dalila as a closed past run and link it from the current revival

show.title: Samson et Dalila
show.synopsis: Saint-Saens's biblical opera of Samson and Dalila, in Darko Tresnjak's production that opened the Met's 2018-19 season.

actions.description: Add the 2022 Met premiere run of Medea as a closed past run and link it from the current revival

show.title: Medea
show.synopsis: Cherubini's retelling of the Euripides tragedy, in David McVicar's production that opened the Met's 2022-23 season.

actions.description: Add the 2012 Met premiere run of Maria Stuarda as a closed past run and link it from the current revival

show.title: Maria Stuarda
show.synopsis: Donizetti's bel canto drama of the rival queens Mary and Elizabeth, in David McVicar's production, the Met's first staging of the opera.

actions.description: Add the 2015 Met premiere run of Otello as a closed past run and link it from the current revival

show.title: Otello
show.synopsis: Verdi's Shakespeare opera, in Bartlett Sher's production that opened the Met's 2015-16 season.

actions.description: Add the 2017 Met premiere run of Der Rosenkavalier as a closed past run and link it from the current revival

show.title: Der Rosenkavalier
show.synopsis: Strauss's comedy of the Marschallin, Octavian and Sophie, in Robert Carsen's production, which opened with Renee Fleming and Elina Garanca.

actions.description: Add the 2013 Met premiere run of Parsifal as a closed past run and link it from the current revival

show.title: Parsifal
show.synopsis: Wagner's final opera about the knight Parsifal and the Grail, in Francois Girard's production, which opened with Jonas Kaufmann.
